study_design: Case-control study comparing prostate cancer patients with non-prostate-cancer controls
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer overall. Its reference to aggressive tumour biology describes the East African disease burden in the background and does not establish an aggressive endpoint analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Specifically, increased intake of red meat (AOR = 5.248), and alcohol (AOR = 2.189) were associated with a high PCa incidence while increased intake of soya (AOR = 0.248), coffee (AOR = 0.603), tomato (AOR = 0.188), and not being married (AOR = 0.147) were associated with lower incidence of PCa in the Tanzanian urban population.
estimate_classifications.reason: Tomato intake is associated with overall prostate cancer in the abstract, without an aggressive subtype endpoint.
